{"type":"thought","data":"I need to check Trump's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" current RCP approval"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rating."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI need to check recent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" polls and the order"}
{"type":"thought","data":" book for edge. I also"}
{"type":"thought","data":" need to verify how "}
{"type":"thought","data":"payouts work."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout structure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is now clear. A 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet at 0.76 for Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" returns roughly 31.6"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens if it wins. "}

{"type":"thought","data":" for No returns roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 316.7 tokens. I need"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to determine what \"winning\""}
{"type":"thought","data":" means in this competition."}

{"type":"thought","data":" scores agents by net"}

{"type":"thought","data":" to pick the most probable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome or the mispriced side with higher expected value."}

{"type":"thought","data":"MacroMicro's October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 12, 2026 RCP approval"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rating is 38. This "}
{"type":"thought","data":"exceeds the 37.4 threshold."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nAsbury Park Press "}
{"type":"thought","data":"reported 37.8% on October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 12, conflicting with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" MacroMicro's 38.1%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The gap between the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" two readings suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" RCP moved during the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" day. Resolution is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"October 16, leaving "}
{"type":"thought","data":"about three days."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRCP polls average "}
{"type":"thought","data":"across roughly two weeks,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so a sharp move is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"unlikely. MacroMicro's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 12 reading "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is only a 0.1 point "}
{"type":"thought","data":"uptick from the prior"}
{"type":"thought","data":" day. Poliwave shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a broader decline: "}
{"type":"thought","data":"39.5% on October 13 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"versus 40.3% three months"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ago and 41.2% six months"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ago. The overall trend"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is downward."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market prices "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Yes at 0.76, implying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly a 76% chance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the rating will stay"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above 37.4. A drop "}
{"type":"thought","data":"of 0.7 points in three"}
{"type":"thought","data":" days is required to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" cross that line, but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" RCP averages are typically"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sticky and only shift"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by 0.1 to 0.3 points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" daily unless a major"}
{"type":"thought","data":" poll enters or exits"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the window. The actual"}
{"type":"thought","data":" RCP page and recent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" trajectory are needed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to judge volatility."}

{"type":"thought","data":"38.1 average, so their"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exit would push the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mean upward. Emerson"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Harvard-Harris "}
{"type":"thought","data":"are slightly above it,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so dropping them would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lower the average. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"If several low polls"}
{"type":"thought","data":" age out without being"}
{"type":"thought","data":" replaced by similarly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" low new polls, the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"approval reading could"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rise, which benefits"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the No side."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRasmussen has held"}
{"type":"thought","data":" steady at 41% for the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" past several days, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"so replacing it would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not shift the average."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Morning Consult's next"}
{"type":"thought","data":" weekly poll likely "}
{"type":"thought","data":"arrives after October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 16, meaning it probably"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will not affect the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" reading. Economist/YouGov"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may release a new poll"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this week that could"}
{"type":"thought","data":" drop the average."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nEconomist/YouGov polls"}
{"type":"thought","data":" often show lower numbers."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A new YouGov poll at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 35–38% would likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" replace the current"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 38% entry and push "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the average downward"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slightly.\n\nReuters/Ipsos"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is another weekly poll"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that could enter this"}
{"type":"thought","data":" week. Its recent readings"}
{"type":"thought","data":" have been low, so replacing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 36% entry with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a similar or lower figure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would pull the average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" down further.\n\nSeveral"}
{"type":"thought","data":" other pollsters—CNN,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Fox, NBC, Quinnipiac,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and NYT/Siena—tend "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to drop in the weeks"}
{"type":"thought","data":" leading up to midterms."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If any of them release"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a low poll before October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 16, it could push the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" approval reading below"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 37.4% threshold."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA single poll replacement"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shifts the 14-poll "}
{"type":"thought","data":"average by (new minus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" old) divided by 14."}
{"type":"thought","data":" To drop the average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by 0.8 points, the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"total sum must fall "}
{"type":"thought","data":"by roughly 11 points."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Replacing Reuters at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 36 with 32 would only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lower the average by"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 0.29 points. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Replacing YouGov at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"38 with 35 would lower"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it by about 0.21 points."}
{"type":"thought","data":" That means a major "}
{"type":"thought","data":"drop below the threshold"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would require several"}
{"type":"thought","data":" polls to shift together"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rather than one."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nAdding a new low poll"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would only drop the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" average by about 0.4"}
{"type":"thought","data":" points. Removing Emerson"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or Harvard-Harris would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" barely shift it. But"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if Quinnipiac and AP/NORC"}
{"type":"thought","data":" both exit, the average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would rise by roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" one point. The biggest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" risk is Pew, AP/NORC,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Quinnipiac aging"}
{"type":"thought","data":" out before October "}
{"type":"thought","data":"16."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nPew is only about "}
{"type":"thought","data":"18 days old, so it will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely remain in the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" average. AP and Quinnipiac"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are roughly 20 days"}
{"type":"thought","data":" old, which falls near"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the three-week cutoff."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The displayed RCP window"}
{"type":"thought","data":" spans 21 days, suggesting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" polls older than about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" three weeks are dropped."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nAging polls alone "}
{"type":"thought","data":"are unlikely to push"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the average below 37.4%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Removing Emerson would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only lower the mean"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by about 0.06 points,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" leaving it near 38.1%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Substantial new low"}
{"type":"thought","data":" polls will be needed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" instead. I should check"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which polls are scheduled"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for release between"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 13 and 16."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nCenter Square/OH Predictive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Insights at 43% is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"not yet in the RCP table."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If added, it would "}
{"type":"thought","data":"raise the average above"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 38.1%. A Financial "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Times poll from October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2–4 shows 33–34% approval,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which could also shift"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the mean downward."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNavigator Research"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 36% is another poll"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that could enter the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" average. The Silver"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Bulletin shows a slight"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bounce rather than "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a collapse, and Poliwave"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has been dropping slowly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by roughly 0.8 points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" per month. The NYT "}
{"type":"thought","data":"poll from October 10"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sits near 37 percent,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" low but steady."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 0.7-point cushion"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is too large for the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" recent 0.08-point daily"}
{"type":"thought","data":" decline to close it"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in three days. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"RCP average sits at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"38.1 because it includes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pew and AP polls that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" other averages might"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exclude or downweight."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A drop of 0.8 points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" within three days is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" possible but unlikely,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" perhaps 15–30% probability,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which conflicts with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market’s 24% No"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price. I am now calculating"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the expected value "}
{"type":"thought","data":"for this bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout structure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is unclear. Past results"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggest favorites pay"}
{"type":"thought","data":" small profits while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" underdogs pay large"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ones, so the 24% No"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price may be a strong"}
{"type":"thought","data":" underdog bet. I need"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to verify the exact"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payout rules before"}
{"type":"thought","data":" choosing an outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nPayouts depend on "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the price at bet time."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A draw market paid "}
{"type":"thought","data":"about 0.79, a rain market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 0.83, and Bitcoin"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Down about 0.53. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exact formula is still"}
{"type":"thought","data":" unclear."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout formula"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is stake divided by"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price minus the stake."}
{"type":"thought","data":" At the current 0.76"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ask, a winning Yes "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bet yields roughly 31.6"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens profit; at the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.24 ask, a winning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No bet yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 317 tokens profit.\n\n"}
{"type":"thought","data":"If the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of Yes is 80%, the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"expected value of a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Yes bet is about +5.3"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens, while the expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value of a No bet is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly -16.7 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This suggests the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is heavily skewed toward"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nIf the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of Yes is 85%, the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"expected value of a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Yes bet rises to about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +11.9 tokens while "}
{"type":"thought","data":"No drops to roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"-37.5. If the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is only 70%, Yes becomes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" -7.9 and No becomes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +25.0. At the market’s"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.76 fair price, both"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sides are nearly break-even"}
{"type":"thought","data":" after accounting for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the spread. Because"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all agents on the same"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side receive similar"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payouts, the competition"}
{"type":"thought","data":" depends on relative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" accuracy rather than"}
{"type":"thought","data":" absolute returns."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe goal is to beat"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the other three agents,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not merely maximize"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value. A correct"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side with wrong picks"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by others creates a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" large edge. The prior"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 7-9 record suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" overbetting favorites"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and losing on draws"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or underdogs. This "}
{"type":"thought","data":"round should prioritize"}
{"type":"thought","data":" accuracy over expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" return."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe \"most likely to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pay off\" framing favors"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the higher-probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side. Picking Yes wins"}
{"type":"thought","data":" more often than No,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so it maximizes the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance of tying or "}
{"type":"thought","data":"outperforming the other"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agents. A correct No"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet would pay off big"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but is too rare to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"be the safest choice."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\n\"Most likely to pay"}
{"type":"thought","data":" off\" means the outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning, which is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes. The 0.7-point "}
{"type":"thought","data":"cushion is large enough"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for a swing of roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.5 points in three"}
{"type":"thought","data":" days."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe latest RCP reading rose to 38.1, and Rasmussen polls are stable at 41. A new low poll could only shift the average by about 0.3–0.5 points, which is too small to close the 0.7-point cushion. I will check Polymarket or Kalshi for the October 16 threshold, review upcoming polls, and inspect the bench history for price trends."}

rating on October 16?\",\"description\":\"This market will resolve according to Donald Trump's approval rating as reported by RealClearPolling at 5:00 PM ET on October 16, 2026.\\n\\nThis market's resolution source will be RealClearPolling's presidential job approval poll average, https://www.realclearpolling.com/polls/approval/donald-trump/approval-rating, specifically the value in the \\\"Approve\\\" column of the \\\"RCP Average\\\" row of the table titled \\\"President Trump Job Approval\\\" as displayed at 5:00 PM ET on the resolution date. Any updates or revisions to the RCP Average published after this time will not be considered, except for corrections of data integrity issues as described below. Changes in the methodology by which RealClearPolling calculates its average will have no bearing on the resolution of this market.\\n\\nIn case of obvious data integrity issues (i.e., erroneous data), the market may remain open until the end of the third calendar day (ET) after the date on which such data is first released to allow for corrections. Data integrity issues refer only to clerical or other similar errors in the underlying data, and do not include cases where RealClearPolling differs from alternative sources.\\n\\nIf the RCP Average is unavailable at 5:00 PM ET on the resolution date, this market may remain open until the end of the third calendar day (ET) after the resolution date. If the RCP Average has not been updated by then, the most recent RCP Average published prior to 5:00 PM ET on the resolution date will be used.\\n\\nThe resolution source reports the rating value to only one decimal point (e.g., 42.8%, 33.9%, etc.).
